info.title: eth-tools API
info.description: Self-maintaining runtime for ERC-8004 trustless agents.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max rows to return; clamped to [1, 200].

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Filter by chain name (e.g. 'base') or chain_id (e.g. '8453').

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a prior response's next_cursor.

400.description: invalid filter (bad chain / bad owner hex)

200.description: Get a single agent by chain and id
Service health, chain registry, indexed agent count

503.description: x402 + wallet rails not yet wired

200.description: Calldata + tx envelope, ready to sign

requestBody.description: Free-form agent-card draft; required fields backfilled.

200.description: Hashes of the raw manifest bytes
List feedback rows for an agent, newest first

steps.description:
Ordered breakdown of which checks ran, what each returned, and the
rule that produced the final answer.

action.description:
Free-form action name (`invoke`, `read_manifest`, …). The policy
engine is the source of truth — handler echoes back.

AgentList.description:
Concrete instantiation of `ListEnvelope<AgentDto>` so the OpenAPI spec
emits a stable `AgentList` schema name (utoipa generates synthetic names
like `ListEnvelope_AgentDto` for raw generic instantiations).

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass verbatim as ?cursor= to page

ApiErrorBody.description: Top-level error envelope returned by every non-2xx response.

value.description:
Decimal string (NUMERIC(40,0)). Combine with `value_decimals` to
interpret as a fixed-point score.

status.description: Always "ok" while the service is responding.

broadcast.description:
Whether to broadcast immediately. When `false`, the wallet rails return
the signed tx in `signed_tx_hex` so the caller can broadcast itself.

args_hex.description: Hex-encoded ABI args (concatenated, no `0x` prefix). Empty = no args.

to.description:
0x-prefixed contract address to call. The wallet rails restrict this
to the three ERC-8004 registries; preview mode is permissive but warns.

agent_id.description: Echoed back so the caller can audit.

calldata.description:
Fully-encoded calldata `0x` + selector + args. Hand this to the
signing rails (or a user's external wallet) — this endpoint never
signs anything.

pointer.description: RFC-6901 JSON Pointer to the failing field, e.g. `/services/0/endpoint`.

manifest.description:
Canonical manifest as a JSON value. The caller can serialize +
hash this to obtain the on-chain `agentURI` payload.

keccak256.description:
0x-prefixed 32-byte hex (keccak256 of the raw bytes — see
`core::manifest::CANONICALIZATION_NOTE`).

bytes_b64.description:
Inline manifest bytes, base64-standard-encoded. Capped at 64 KiB so
a buggy client can't OOM the function.

uri.description:
Fetch the manifest from this URI (https://, ipfs://). Either `uri` OR
`bytes_b64` must be set, not both.

errors.description: Empty when `valid == true`. Each entry is a JSON Pointer + message.

source.description:
Echoed back so the caller can correlate (`uri` if URL-sourced; empty
when bytes were inlined).

ReputationList.description: Concrete instantiation for stable schema name — see `AgentList` doc.

chain.description: Chain name (`base`) or chain_id as decimal string (`8453`). Omit for any.

query.description: Substring matched against `agent_uri` ILIKE. Omit for "any URI".

request_hash.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte hex (the canonical hash of the request_uri body).
0x-prefixed 32-byte hex of the request being responded to.

tags.name: invoke
tags.description: Calldata prep + on-chain execution (stubbed until wallet rails)
